== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Beskar Deflection]] (original printing), Virtual Set 20, as the PC published it on 11 December 2022, taken unchanged from the PC's card-image repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/23a3730ee5dc43921699d347d0a1ea05f8f2848a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual20-Light/large/beskardeflection.gif holotable commit 23a3730], file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual20-Light/large/beskardeflection.gif</code>; a PNG file served under a .gif name). Not a recreation.
